You quit school to help run a small Bakery Shop. Cook, stock shelves, sell to customers, and start a new life in 🍓 Cook & Sell!

❓How to Play:
👨‍🍳 Buy ingredients from your desk 🖥️
🍓 Unbox in your Kitchen, drop ingredients into your Pot to cook!
🍰 Stock your shop with treats to attract customers!
🧑 Scan Customers' bags & take payment! 💵
🏆 Complete Goals to unlock better recipes! 💖
